title: server.create (platform → host, reliable)
description: Provision new server-N folder(s). With enroll: true, csm writes fleet_url and fleet_enroll_key (from `fleet`) into each new server so Ready Up self-enrolls (FLEET.md §4.1 B, §18.4). `fleet` is a platform addition to §18.2: a code-enrolled csm has no fleet key of its own. The key is minted per command and limited to `count` servers. Answered by exactly one host.result (envelope ref = this message's id). FLEET.md §18.2.
